new_results: Exact height-p transport identity: S(x,p,t) is half the real part of the logarithmic derivative of a Gaussian average of the completed function, recentred at the Gamma saddle (Lemmas 3.1-3.3).
Explicit remainder from Euler-product majorants, the digamma function and partial summation, with no Riemann-Siegel formula or zero-free region (Proposition 4.5, Theorem 4.6).
Upper bound for the vertical derivative of S by Cauchy's estimate (Corollary 5.1).
Floating evaluation on a 20-point time grid: no loss of the time-zero floor for conductors at least 1.084e5 (even) and 4.892e4 (odd) at p = sqrt5, and for zeta at x >= X (numerical, not certified).
34-row table from the classical strip giving Lambda <= 0.18891 conditional on the analytic lemmas of arXiv:2610.12803v1 (a cross-check, not a record).
claims_not_made: No unconditional bound on Lambda or Lambda_chi.
No outward-rounded certification of the remainder E or of Corollary 5.1.
No proof of the analytic lemmas of arXiv:2610.12803v1 on which Proposition 7.5 rests.
No priority or record claim: unrefereed preprints claim stronger bounds from the same start.
No RH conclusion and no accepted or formally reviewed manuscript milestone.
